         **Review examples:**
            1. _Adan Phu_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "I transferred my money to Robinhood, bought some stocks, then sold them. I was trying to transfer all my money to Webull after my money was settled. Robinhood restricted my account. I am unable to trade, nor contact support. I don’t feel safe at all. Very sketchy.             2. _D.O.Double_, Jul 23, 2026, 5/5: "Most important of said-tweaks is the inability to customize the time intervals given in the advanced charting process. I do quick options trades all the time and when I look at the advanced charts, the default time interval given is “5 YEARS.” For those who aren’t familiar w/ options, 5 years is the absolute LAST time interval anyone would ever use, period. But there’s no way to change this default of 5-years permanently. So imagine how many times I - and COUNTLESS OTHERS - have to change the entire chart from 5-years worth of advanced trading data, down to today’s, at 30 secs per interval. Or lower. I HOPE someone reading this can understand the brevity of this situation, in that, it needs changing immediately. Because if I’m having troubles, I guarantee THOUSANDS more are having exactly the same issue."
